subtasks.title: Org bird's-eye lists all active org kits (drop kit_settings-row filter)
subtasks.approach: In app/Http/Controllers/Api/ClarityScoutBirdsEyeController.php, rewrite orgScoutKits(int $orgId): query Kit::query()->forOrg($orgId) with leftJoin('kit_metadata', kits.id = kit_metadata.kit_id)->whereNull('kit_metadata.deleted_at')->select('kits.*')->orderBy('name')->get() (mirroring Kit::getKits(withDeleted:false)'s soft-delete exclusion — inline, NOT calling getKits, which selects only id,name and is hourly-cached). Keep the separate keyed KitSettings lookup (cross-connection: Kit on zod, kit_settings on platform) and setRelation('settings', $settings->get($kit->id)) for each kit, leaving it null when absent — but DROP the ->filter(fn ($kit) => $settings->has($kit->id)) line so non-enrolled kits are retained. Do not cache (the map must reflect kit changes live). Update the drivers() and orgScoutKits() docblocks to describe 'all non-deleted org kits' instead of 'Scout-enrolled kits (those with a kit_settings row)'. TDD: first rewrite the existing test that pins the old settings-required exclusion so it asserts the new behavior, confirm red, then implement to green.
subtasks.intended_diffs: orgScoutKits(): replace `Kit::query()->forOrg($orgId)->orderBy('name')->get()` + `->filter($settings->has(...))` with a forOrg + leftJoin kit_metadata + whereNull deleted_at + select('kits.*') query, and remove the filter() so every returned kit is kept (settings attached when present, null otherwise). Docblocks on drivers() (l.50-54) and orgScoutKits() (l.648-657) reworded. Test: the old exclusion test rewritten to assert (a) a kit with NO kit_settings row appears with null driver_name/vehicle_type, (b) a kit with kit_metadata.deleted_at set is excluded, (c) cross-org kits never leak; plus a test that a non-enrolled kit's kit_id is honored by a scopedKits-derived endpoint (hits/stats kit_ids filter).
